rule_summary: Changing ComfyUI node sockets requires changing both declared types and Python logic.
image_to_latent_rules: Do not treat IMAGE and LATENT as interchangeable.
If the original function does pixel/PIL/OpenCV/RGB operations, keep IMAGE or bridge through VAEDecode/VAEEncode.
If the function operates on latent tensors, operate on latent["samples"] and preserve extra latent keys.
For published nodes, use node replacement/migration rules when renaming or changing input names/types.
Prefer workflow-level bridges before custom node mutation for beginner users.
